# `silk/p384`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Bounded ECDSA P-384/SHA-384 verification for certificate signatures.

## When to use

Use [`EcdsaP384Sha384`](#EcdsaP384Sha384) to verify borrowed messages or retained certificate metadata.

## Details

Uses secp384r1 from [Standards for Efficient Cryptography 2 (SEC 2)](https://www.secg.org/sec2-v2.pdf),
version 2.0, section 2.5.1. Field and order arithmetic use fixed
twelve-limb Montgomery residues and complete projective addition for a = -3.
Verification hashes the message once and accepts strict DER signatures with 1 <= r,s < n.
All operations use inline storage; no allocator, entropy, or foreign crypto service is needed.

## Gotchas

Verifying a signature establishes neither trust nor certificate identity, time, or usage.
This module exposes verification only; it does not provide signing or key agreement.

Import as `EcdsaP384Sha384` with `import silk.p384 { EcdsaP384Sha384 }`.

<a id="EcdsaP384Sha384.impl.validatePublicKey"></a>

### Associated function `validatePublicKey`

```silk
pub fn validatePublicKey(publicKey: &[u8]) -> Result<(), P384SignatureError>
```

Admits exactly one finite, on-curve, uncompressed secp384r1 public key.

#### Details

Requires `04 || X || Y`, canonical 48-byte coordinates below the field prime, and the
curve equation. The curve has cofactor one. Compressed points and infinity are rejected.

<a id="EcdsaP384Sha384.impl.verify"></a>

### Associated function `verify`

```silk
pub fn verify(publicKey: &[u8], message: &[u8], signature: &[u8]) -> Result<
    (),
    P384SignatureError,
  >
```

Hashes the borrowed message exactly once and verifies a strict DER signature.

#### Details

The key must be 97-byte uncompressed SEC1. Both high-s and low-s are accepted.
All representable slice lengths fit SHA-384's length field. No entropy or allocation is required.

<a id="EcdsaP384Sha384.impl.verifyCertificate"></a>

### Associated function `verifyCertificate`

```silk
pub fn verifyCertificate<'key, 'sig>(
    keyAlgorithm: &AlgorithmView<'key>,
    publicKey: &BitStringView<'key>,
    message: &[u8],
    signatureAlgorithm: &AlgorithmView<'sig>,
    signature: &BitStringView<'sig>,
  ) -> Result<(), P384SignatureError>
```

Verifies retained certificate key and signature metadata against the borrowed message.

#### Details

Requires id-ecPublicKey with named secp384r1, ecdsa-with-SHA384 with absent parameters,
and zero unused bits. Performs no certificate extraction, trust-path or identity validation.
